name: iwant.fyi
title: iwant.fyi -- demand-side commerce
description: Demand-side commerce MCP server: AI agents express structured purchase intent on behalf of a user and receive matched supply -- real products with live prices, ranked across multiple sources. Reference implementation of the iwant.fyi demand-side protocol v1.1. MCP-native with an HTTP fallback.

authentication.note: initialize and tools/list are public (no key) so clients and reviewers can inspect the server. A free key unlocks tools/call.

featured_tools.name: demand.search
featured_tools.title: Find products (ephemeral search)
featured_tools.description: Find products to buy across multiple supply sources for a natural-language query. Returns ranked matches with live prices; persists nothing.

featured_tools.name: demand.create_want
featured_tools.title: Buy: create a Want and get matches
featured_tools.description: Record a buyer's structured purchase intent (a Want) and return matched supply. The buyer-side primitive.

featured_tools.name: demand.create_watch
featured_tools.title: Create a standing want (watch)
featured_tools.description: Register persistent buy-intent that re-matches on a schedule and notifies via webhook when NEW matching supply appears.

tools_list_endpoint.note: Public (no key). Call for the full, current set of 19 tools.
